children: Shareholders approved a rights issue of up to 151,799,640 shares at SEK 1.00 each, which would raise approximately SEK 151.8M before issue costs if fully subscribed. Subscription runs from 26 November to 10 December 2026; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Up to SEK 151.8M gross if fully subscribed
The rights issue provides potential new capital, but the amount is conditional on full subscription and excludes issue costs.
Up to 151,799,640 shares at SEK 1.00 each
The substantial share issuance may dilute existing holders; participation depends on subscription.
Three rights entitle holders to subscribe for two shares
Existing holders can participate pro rata, subject to the stated subscription ratio.
The defined window sets the near-term timetable for subscriptions and funding.
Board may issue shares as guarantee compensation
The authorization permits additional shares for guarantors, with the issue price matching the rights issue.

This is a concrete capital-raising event approved by shareholders, rather than a report of operating performance. Subscription results and the final amount raised will determine the realized funding and dilution.
